name: exists_smul_notMem_of_subset_orbit_closure
statement: Set G) (T : Set α) {a : α} (hS : ∀ g ∈ S, g⁻¹ ∈ S) (subset : T ⊆ orbit (closure S) a) (notMem : a ∉ T) (nonempty : T.Nonempty) : ∃ σ ∈ S, ∃ a ∈ T, σ • a ∉ T

name: swap_mem_closure_isSwap
statement: Set (Perm α)} (hS : ∀ f ∈ S, f.IsSwap) {x y : α} : swap x y ∈ closure S ↔ x ∈ orbit (closure S) y

have_tree.body: exists_smul_notMem_of_subset_orbit_closure S {x | swap x y ∈ closure S}

name: surjective_of_isSwap_of_isPretransitive'
statement: Set G) (hS1 : ∀ σ ∈ S, MulAction.toPermHom G α σ = 1 ∨ Perm.IsSwap (MulAction.toPermHom G α σ)) (hS2 : Subgroup.closure S = ⊤) [h : MulAction.IsPretransitive G α] : Function.Surjective (MulAction.toPermHom G α)
